sourceReviewStatus: Agent source-scope and numerical review; no specialist or human learner review implied

sources.locator: Caching; Attention matrices; Cache class items 1–3; Cache position
sources.supports: Previously computed causal K/V can be retained; new entries and absolute positions advance with processed input tokens.
sources.limits: Versioned documentation checked. Our single-layer implementation uses the existing model normalization and positional conventions; no Transformers dependency or general training-cache claim.

sources.locator: Section 3, S1 Iteration-level scheduling (PDF p. 5 / printed p. 525), selecting one iteration, updating request pool, joining/removing requests; abstract
sources.supports: Requests can join/leave at iteration boundaries rather than waiting for a whole request batch to finish.
sources.limits: Only the mechanism is used. Our logical lanes execute serially, reservation/FIFO rules are authored, and no paper speedup or distributed-runtime claim is reproduced.

sources.locator: Sections 2.1–2.3, equations 1–3, prompt/autoregressive phases; section 3 memory challenges and section 3.1 reserved slots; sections 4.1–4.3 define paged allocation for contrast
sources.supports: Autoregressive input/output dependency, cached K/V growth, iteration batching, and explicit KV-capacity limits.
sources.limits: No vLLM implementation, paged allocation, preemption, prefix sharing, hardware memory ratio or empirical speedup claimed. Numeric 96-byte denominator comes from our one-layer binary64 model, not the paper example.

sources.locator: Section 3.1 quantize/dequantize equation and error study; sections 3.2–3.3 grouping and residual-cache mechanisms
sources.supports: Quantization maps cache values to codes/scales, reconstructs values for attention and can alter downstream accuracy.
sources.limits: Our authored symmetric per-row signed 4-bit format is not KIVI grouping/asymmetric 2-bit or residual-cache algorithm; no paper accuracy/memory/speed results transferred.

sources.locator: Sections 2.1–2.3 and Algorithm 1, conditional proposal evaluation, first rejection, dependent suffix discard and output correction; sections 3.3–3.4 separate work from hardware-dependent wall time
sources.supports: Target verification must preserve valid conditioning state and correct at a rejected proposal; greedy argmax can be represented as a degenerate target distribution.
sources.limits: Our proposals are authored IDs, not learned. Verification is binary64 greedy with at most two outputs and explicit KV discard/recovery. No stochastic p/q acceptance, corrected distribution sampling, bonus output, parallel execution or measured acceleration claim.

checks.unitsAndDenominators: 96 binary64 numeric payload bytes per single-layer/single-head position; reserved and occupied distinct; logical scalar reads and multiply-add pairs exclude other arithmetic and hardware transactions; synthetic ticks do not mean time measurements. Quantized payload includes six packed code bytes plus sixteen scale bytes per position; same fixed byte capacity. Approximation error and greedy token changes explicitly separate from exact reference equality.
checks.modelAssumptions: 423-parameter decoder, frozen source weights, independent request RNG, bounded inputs/outputs, conservative capacity reservation, FIFO, logical serial execution, no paged allocator or timing model. Optional per-row symmetric int4 KV with binary64 scales and dequantized arithmetic; authored two-token speculative proposal with exact binary64 target verification and dependent-cache discard.
checks.claimQualifiers: Numerical outputs and KV tensors are executed; schedule policies and resource limits are authored. Training/development fixture feedback is separated from final test. No empirical system speedups transferred. No learned draft, stochastic speculative sampling, KIVI implementation or speedup claim.
checks.dependencyAndVisualScope: Lifecycle/distributed full state retained; live cache and post-release diagnostic snapshot distinctly labeled; source exposure journal persists across old imports. UI exposes actual request outputs and computed cache values.
